sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Wooden ammo box is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Wooden ammo boxes are 3x3 containers that only spawn ammo.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The container is based on the standard Warsaw Pact ammo crate. Its dimensions were 488mm Long × 353mm Wide × 151mm High, giving it a volume of 0.026 Cubic Meters (0.918 Cubic Feet). Each ammo crate contained 2 hermetically-sealed sheet-steel "spam cans" and a large steel can opener.
